gaps.gap: No effective food-component dump or loaded recipe manager. Catalog identifies released item families, not a complete numeric hunger, saturation, reward or stack-limit inventory.
Representative class weapons, named armor sets, Arsenal uniques and Cataclysm examples are cataloged. No claim of complete boss reward sources or effective loaded attributes.

Packaged category definitions and named roots inspected. Datapack merging and effective node availability require runtime verification. Pufferfish Skills is the engine used by Skill Tree, not a separate skill system.
Only native item models used. No screenshots, generated art or publisher image claims. Native models retain archive license and source provenance; no textures copied.

translation_policy: Use installed Chinese spell labels when present; translate missing active ability names editorially. Native ItemLink uses the installed item language, which may fall back to the publisher English name.
